items.note: Good because it helps alleviate Ivy's poor magazine size problem. Gives more long term damage output for wave at the start, which means its a good alternative/supplement to Monster Rounds.

Gun Ivy's BEST early/mid game item. Procs easily with ivy's high ROF, grants amazing jungle/camp clear, and allows easy proccage of debuffs. It is INSANE.
This item is better the earlier you buy it, B/C Capacitor requires FAR LESS ROF to consistently proc than Tesla Bullets. Its active is a great substitute for ivy losing knockup on ultimate.
Slight damage increase. Powerspike more noticable when you buy swift striker.
INSANE item to buy if you want to postpone your 4.8k HP investment spike, to buy more items for farming and powerspikes, without being super squishy and burstable.
This item has INSANE value, even outside of lane. You will NEVER regret or feel bad buying this item, as it keeps you topped up for HP after camps, and gives sprint speed!
If planning to be hyper-active in the early game right after capacitor, this can be a good pickup against early healing characters. Otherwise, get crippling late. (~§35k+ souls)
Best § 800 item in lane for winning lane and applying pressure. If buying, I reccomend going Extnd. Mag -> Headshot Booster -> Tesla for you 4.8k Gun Spike build order.

Best § 1600 item for raw unconditional firerate, while giving bonus sprint speed that very useful in the early game. Helps immensely with giving the exact fire rate you need for capacitor w T3 Tether.

Given that your character has a short reload time (Ivy does), this item is great, as you will be allowed to easily proc it to gain very high value stats, such as lots of firerate, movespeed, lifesteal
Easy to apply with Tesla/Capacitor, and provides a great Bullet Resist Shred debuff while giving spirit investment, and good base stats.
Ivy's base kit has absolutely insane amounts of healing. This will make your bullet lifesteal from tether and stone form heal be far more effective, as well as headhunter. Builds into healing tempo.
Required every game for the current spirit meta, and works well with creating more EHP (Effective HP) with siphon bullets.
Insane counter to Infernus/Mirage on-hit buildups, and generally great for any enemy that is causing a debuff that is causing you to lose or die constantly. (Also good if spirit burned nonstop late.)

Now offers 35-50% effective bullet resistance. Compared to escalating resil with its poor stats (30%), this gives far more, and keeps you alive at low hp (which you have lots of sustain to heal from).
Insanely Overpowered, but situational. Hard counters Haze/Vyper/Gun Warden, Gun Drifter, and ANY character that has ~X > 75% damage done by pure weapon damage bullets.
Great item for mid-game firerate saturation. You want to hit a target of around +100-120% firerate by the time you are full build. Slide distance and movespeed this item gives is very good.
Though it doesnt give raw stats, the latest slow change where regular slows also effect air dashing can certainly make this item more desirable. Reccomended if up a walker flex slot.

When bought at around 20-25k souls, this item will actually feel effective due to characters starting to be at the 2500-3000HP range. Optimally, you want enemies to be at 3k+HP for this item to SHINE.
Can be bought earlier to make use of raw trade damage it provides. Real value comes from large % heal that is impactful late game when you are 4000-5000HP.
Often has more value if you buy this when behind to support other m1s, though you can still retain a fair amount of value from this item due to its abundance of passive stats.
Combined with Siphon bullets, and utilizing Ivy's above average health scaling, it gives great health value, and the dash slow on this item is INSANE. Great also if you have x < 15% of both resists.
Better with the diminishing movespeed buffs, and direct juggernaut movespeed buffs. Still, this item is optimal if you are using it to counter other m1s.
VERY good debuff that counts as antiheal and a massive damage reduction. Easy to buildup with your current firerate, and when bought, gives ~350 HP and +10% wpn damage in raw stats (Very Good)
While inhibitor is great, this item INSTANTLY applies the damage debuff without needing a buildup. Great for spirit meta. Built-In Silence is also great for countering. Do note this gives no HP.
Deletes victor, and heavily cripples any character that has high resists with high healing/sustain. Long debuff duration and easy proc makes it SUPER useful for your team needing damage.
You will have enough firerate to reproc it even when its debuff removed (At around T3 tether max). This makes it a good antiheal option for mid-late game, and really shines late with high HP pools.
Very good upgrade that mainly serves to give you debuff resist that you may otherwise be lacking in the midgame. Damage is great too. Good because other sources of debuff resist are very expensive.
Gives all the late game stats you are lacking, and want more of. Provides a layer of protection against spirit nukers, and gives slightly more resistance to what you already have, with debuff resist.

This item is great against pick characters (Mo Krill, Holliday, Paradox, Bepop, etc.) But not reccomended until §40k+ souls. It doesnt get triggered by knockups/airbornes (except mirage FUCK YOU mirag
VERY SITUATIONAL. Very good counter against Haze and Infernus. If not enough against on-hit characters, combining this with Dispel Magic practically makes their on-hits completely irrelevant.
Great when the team is only managing to kill you through CC/Stuns, or curses and countless debuffs of similar sort. Also gives survivability with massive debuff resistance and some HP.

Good as a early hard-counter to m1 characters during lane, or right after lane. Can be bought right after tesla for maximum value, though delaying capacitor is risky. Earlier fire rate slow is better.

With regular slows effecting air dashes as well now, this item can give you a little bit of the best of both worlds, making both movespeed and crazy airdashing harder, get only if you have many slots.

When imbued on ult, and you are carrying people off cooldown, you can be perma rotating around mid-game skirmishes getting major map control and granting you a lead. Good if you have/know u have slots

Treat this as a § 50k+ Soul Luxury item to let you proc Headhunter, Siphon, and Capacitor faster, alongside giving ability cooldowns. Very high value late game, but useless if you are buying it early.
A very good replacement for Bullet Resist Shredder, when you are heavily slot locked, but have money to spend. Usually only do this at § 35k+ souls when you are missing slots from walkers.
Here for the sake of being an easily accessible component for when you want to buy crippling headshot, and have a slot to spare for it. ONLY BUY IF BUILDING FOR CRIPPLING.

Super nice for staying topped up in lane. Buy later if somehow not getting damaged. Can be replaced with Healing Rite.
Prereq to Opening Rounds, its okay!
Gives great early stats, you love it all.
Early bump in survivability and damage. Rarely can switch for Healbane to get it earlier.
Default buy but 75% of the time, buy Slow Hex or Suppressor instead to counter. This is just efficient stats.

Anti heal is great and burst heal is insanely nice too. Sell super late for Spirit Burn or other anti heal. 4.8k Health spike here.
Builds into Ballistic now, its fine. Skippable if not taking Ballistic.
Consistent damage and a ton of range. Can take Cultist instead for less ball focus.  (If you wanna build Ball, you need some kind of range)
A good spike in spirit damage, doesn't stack with other teammates with the same item.
Disgusting damage boosting item. Don't forget, the shred is for your whole team but the Passive Amp from EE is just for you.
A ton of healing to keep you healthy during (and in between) fights and jungling.
Component for Rapid Recharge, it's okay. Sometimes you can slot this in whenever if you have spare money and slots.
Ball CDR and CD between charges is generally helpful. This isn't a rush buy, if you have a lot banked get Overflow instead etc.
A solid global upgrade to your whole kit, so much spirit. You can skip this for other End Game buys, this is very consistent though and buffs everything.
Highest anti-heal in the game. Reworked to be per target, actually feels decent to pick up late game. You can even rush this as second/third tier 4 if no one on your team has and you need it bad.

Can replace Improved Spirit early, absolutely destroys certain heroes (like 50% of the cast), very strong.
Can replace Improved Spirit. Very strong against gun heavy heroes, everyone needs to shoot in lane though!
A massive stat stick and you love all of it. Getting built out of Lifesteal is crazy nice.
A huge amount of lifesteal and damage output on command. Check Leech for replacement info.
A ton of shred AND anti-heal but relies on headshots. Great as a gun investment filler late game. Check replacements for more info.
I don't think its better than Duration early, requires a bigger buy in to effect items. With no toxic it can definitely see use late game. Stack EE faster and proc Spirit Burn more.
Mid item on its own, but Magnum makes it worth. Helps with ammo.
It's a good item for improving your 1v1 potential but it struggles with Seven's low bullet growth and fire rate being mid.
Mostly troll pickup but sometimes you never want to sell Slowing Hex so might as well upgrade it and get bonus range too!
Great item for Spirit damage. Consider Spellbreaker instead for high burst spirit.
Great against fed gun carries, suddenly you live 10x longer than they expect, and gives time for your team to help out.
Very popular item if you're good enough to use it, either against big damage or incoming CC, Lash, Bebop, Mo, etc.
Really nice item for dispelling kinda anything. Any debuffs or stacking abilties, even incoming abilities like Bebop bomb.
Good for laning against CC heavy heroes, builds into indomitable now.
Amazing if you are getting CC'ed a ton. Hard requirement if you want to ult a lot.
A good anti gun late game item, helps with on hit effects like Infernus and Haze, or M1s who like to build ricochet etc.
Decent against gun AND melee damage. Consider Plated Armor or Metal Skin instead.
Gives a nice amount of speed and passively counters gun and melee heavy teams. It's very solid.
Good if the Spirit damage is mainly burst, with debuff resist on top. Sometimes Resilience is better if it is more consistent chip or drain though.
If you are getting dived a lot this might buy you valuable seconds for your team to help. Big buff after too!
Theoretically nice early for countering damage early, but you don't really want to fight early, so get damage and buy better defensives later imo.
Same notes as spirit shielding but for gun.
Compy ult build? Probably not.
An alternative to Speed items, if you think you need them.
Can swap with Ballistic if you think you just want to farm and get bonus souls. Worse for fighting generally and need to play around the buff timer.

Kinda similar use case to Crippling Headshot, can get technically higher shred with repeat headshots but not sure it's worth.

Used to be the goat but other 1.6k items just feel more impactful.
Not using this for HP spike anymore but you could take it instead of Regen and HP, but feels less needed now.

Could replace Imp Spirit early, I just find this item clunky.

0.description:
Full Guide: youtube.com/watch?v=YGkB3pHe088 (made half a year ago so some parts outdated but info is still relevant).
(There is a Heroic Aura version of this build use search).

Twitch.tv/Elendilli rare streams

If you have questions, ask me @Elendilli in the Official Deadlock Discord in the #McGinnis channel.

This build focuses on maxing ultimate which deals infinity damage (Midboss/Enemy base is our best place to use it). Turrets are secondary to ult but turrets still scale really well into mid/late game

items.note: Buy if you think that you can get away with gun in the lane. Your goal when you buy this is you will shoot the enemy a lot with your gun + take guardian faster after 5 min.
In lane use them to shove wave. YOu can now spawn turrets to push the wave unlike before because we have so many charges from the T2 upgrade. Spam turrets if you are near max charges for info on map.
Game changer of an item in lane. Extra stamina alone can let you play like a 3 stamina Hero. Builds into Arcane Surge.
Arcane Surge before using Ult and Heal (if maxed, otherwise don't bother) and late game for turrets, especially effective during base defense or base sieges.
Slows down enemies hit by wall and turrets even more allowing your ally or your ultimate to deal more consistent damage. Builds into Lightning scroll later.
Imbued on ultimate by default to make the AoE gigantic. Remember to buy Compress CDR on ult if it's on cooldown before this.
S tier item this patch because spirit damage is META. This provides offensive and defensive bonuses the best of both worlds + CDR.
Our best item for mobility during ultimate. A must buy item if doing ult build. Remember, you can climb stuff then mantle boost during ult which bypasses the ult self slow.
PUSH WAVE AS FAST AS POSSIBLE.
Buy this to lower ULT CD. Make sure you buy it BEFORE you ult because it won't lower CDR if ULT is on cooldown anymore (it used to).
Buy early to apply your third debuff when spirit damage is applied via mainly ultimate, but turrets and wall can too. Your teammates also benefit from this reduction on enemies.
Escalating is better than Boundless after exactly 4.23s of gaining stacks (6 stacks) without any time lag inbetween. Boundless for this test had Mystic Vuln while Escalating had Improved Spirit.
Allows you to air dash move across the map & scale buildings or maneuver your ult against close range enemies with more air dashes, jumps etc... BEST ITEM EVER.
Buy when you want ULT SPLASH AOE BIGGER (THEY CANT JUMP) + turrets to have very high ability range to attack from very far distances. Also applies to heal and ult AoE.
Extremely efficient duration for its cost on Ult. Allows you to have significant Ult uptime. Remember to pair it with Unstoppable and/or Indomitable so you are guaranteed to keep the ult going.
Buy this generally to make items like Unstoppable last longer so that you have more ult uptime.
Buy when enemies keep stunning you out of your ult. ALWAYS use unstoppable before ulting. Sometimes use METAL SKIN before ulting too. Pairs well w/ sup duration.
Buy when you have placed all your turrets/heal and YOU are about to end the game. Place another batch of turrets and another ultimate. Good for base defense or sieges after using up all cooldowns

This is the 2nd best power increase you can buy in the game while Escalating Exposure is the 1st for 6400 items. Remember that you will get 15% spirit power so make sure you do your SINNERS/STATUE-MAX
1) Hits the last breakpoint for spirit power investment (with all listed items AND rapid recharge), 2) Buy when doing midboss or defending. The CDR is for turret spam with Sup duration.

categories.name: Lightning Scroll / Heroic Aura / Utility (Not required, optional items)

items.note: Buy ONLY if enemies have channeled spells like Dynamo Ult, Haze ult, Mo&K Ult, Seven Ult (before he ults) etc.. This item becomes less worth it the higher rank you get (I don't buy it at all in Eter5)
Fire rate for turrets. Indespensible for wall max 1st or turrets during MIDBOSS or BASE DEFENSE. Remember to spread turrets the AoE for Heroic is decently big.
Buy this when nobody on your team has Healbane and you desperately need anti-heal. Turrets and ult even wall can apply this.
We have 2 charges on T2 turrets now so this isn't exactly required all the time now. It will take a long time to place x5 turrets while it coolsdown and you get another so x6 etc..
OUR WAVE/LANE/TROOPER CLEAR IS SOOOO BAD that this item is OKAY for big waves but it works for ur team. And we can use it before ulting for our teammates + high burn damage.

This will basically make you immortal during your ult vs stuns (if no unstop). It is hard to justify buying both this and Unstop. If Lash ults ults/Haze sleeps or Abrams ult, it activates before stun.
MORE ULT CDR VERY NICE
Buy this against Heroes like Vyper or Haze ult. With Transcendent Cooldown, Metal Skin is 14 cd which is very low. Superior Duration increases makes this go from 5s to 6.4s (HUGE DIFF).
Good. From 2% heal to 2.4% heal.
Buy this to ultra buff turret fire rate especially in areas like Midboss or other areas where you have setup turrets. Healing Nova can also apply Tempo to turrets instead of your Specter.
requires Trans CD if you actually want to make a full build around it (the item CDR matters).
Superior Cooldown does the job just fine. The only time you consider TransCD is when you need item cooldowns.
Buy first in lane sometimes over Monster Rounds for more direct HERO damage so less damage to troopers and guardian overall, but more Hero poke/kill power/melee resist for wall + burger boxing.
1) Hit 4800, 2) Move around the map really fast + no speed loss for box/statue maxxing. 3) Remember to activate Fleetfoot before using ULT (you can't use it during ult cuz bad QoL).
Reload with lifesteal. Buy this sometimes along with Intensifying Mag to play gun in lane to have more lane presence (and objective damage).

Buy this for wave clear and not for the Ablity Range. Very good item I buy it cuz I often heavy melee + shoot the waves often and still takes forever to kill. This solves clear1 better than Alch Fire.
If you think you can get away with it. this item becomes worse in higher level games unfortunately.
This was an item you could buy late game if you had 1600 and an open slot for the next fight, but now it also has an upgrade that is REALLY GOOD.
If you think that you need spirit lifesteal during ult to leech more because you are tanking hits from enemies, buy this.

You are buying this for unstoppable anyway, but if you buy it earlier, know that you can do things like once lash slams you with ult, you can spawn wall since u have debuff resist b4 he slams and wall
We usually don't need this item unless the enemy team has 5 or more spirit Heroes.
its a secret
Sometimes you need counterspell for Lash ult (he can hold his ult sometimes to bypass Counterspell) or just in general against other forms of stun/cc.
Warp stone is very good for scaling buildings or getting out of bad situations. Can go further depending on ability range items as well.
If you have Healing Tempo you can give your allies AND TURRETS the TEMPO buff without using Healing Specter.
Buy when you need to cast all your spells before dying. Cheat death duration can also be increased with duration items to ensure you cast ALL your spells before dying (or escape!).
Good if you have too much money and no slots.

Buy after shoving the wave (dont always buy 1st think ok). Basically USE/HATCH AFter min 10:01 for MAXIMUM value (buffs upgrade at 10:00). Generally you pop this around ~10-20 for your next 6400 item.
Sometimes you want less firerate via turret but I wouldn't recommend this for ult-maxxing most of the time b/c slots are already limited. If you decide to do more gun or turret consider it.
Buy against enemies like Wraith or Dynamo or Stamina abusers like Celeste to prevent them from escaping which essentially forces them to make Magic Dispel.
Sometimes the game is about to end whether you win / lose or a critical fight and you just so happen to have 3200 + need anti heal. Decay someone. The range is NUTS w/ Greater exp.
Buy when you need severe anti-heal and they have no sign of debuff remover. You can't reliaby target whoever you want with spirit burn unless you ult.
Vortex enemies, press unstoppable if you grabbed a few, ult them.
Pretty strong item these past few patches. Use on ally or yourself. Inside heal ur basically taking zero from spirit
Hatecrime someone.

0.description:
[Kinetic Carbine does not have damage fall off, you can easily hit cross map 2k damage time shots.]

Kinetic Carbine has very interesting item synergies, this build has all of the ones that work, making it the best and original Paradox one-shot build.

items.note: Fun fact, Paradox Kinetic Carbine shot actually has travel speed, very strange for a literal shot of time energy but eh.
Don't sell until giga late game, it's essentially the perfect item for sniping.
Early game with these 3 items 3 starts dealing like 200 damage every 15s.// The early game isn't changed too much, but the damage drop really hurts late, be less hesitant to buy Mercurial Magnum.
Kind of goated, second highest pure damage item we get. //4.8k spike.
Just walk up to people for assists as they die. Sell lategame first once your slot locked and need T4's.//Every soul generating item got nerfed, so this thing is still good, relatively speaking.
Massive 3 damage, try to play around the cooldown, 3's cooldown starts ticking as soon as you start charging it, so you can wait for the very last second with no downtime.//Still good.
Veil walker got cooked, so Fortitude is back baby, and even better then before, the healing buff is minimal, but it's still a buff. Gives you 4.8k health, and a lot of global map pressure.
Testing has shown that this item outperforms Hollow Point for sniping, because of the large added damage to your shots, but unfortunately Carbine only gets the smaller secondary fire damage buff.
Good damage and the effect procks with carbine, so your target will lose resists and be easier to kill for you or your team, now it's almost always just better then Weighted Shots.
For those who have a soft spot for Veil Walker, you can still build it, even if it got decimated by the nerfs, it's still fun.
This item is underrated, which is strange, since everyone buys it, but I promise it is absurdly good for keeping space, it will save you far more often then 90% of greens.
This is literally just 50% more damage, and the aoe will easily deal thousands of damage in teamfights.
Highest gun damage item in the game, and since our playstyle is so safe its incredibly easy to stack.
Big nerfs to this item, in pure damage it is still the best option, but not by far, consider Crippling Headshot more often if they don't have healers.

It's mostly useful in longer fights, not as good for pure sniping, still, has massive value in teamfights, try to go for headshots if you're too far away to target one person, applying it to everyone.
Finish our gun investments, and good for normal gun damage. | You can replace it with a green that gives ~15% gun damage (since thats how much you get from final investment) if you wont m1.
Last item, we swap Mystic Shot for this, and altough our 3 damage does go down a bit, our base gun damage goes up.//The nerfs to this thing don't hit us nearly as hard as others, so it's still good.
The extra health does help in lane, and if you're going up against a melee/dangerous lane, you can pick it up early, especially since we're back to building Fortitude.
We take Stamina over other greens because it helps us stay out of other champion's effective range, we dont need to mitigate damage that we dont take.
Goated item, 15m is a lot less then you'd think, if your playing right your going to have the damage nigh permanently.
Low prio, it's decent if your entire team is gun carries tho.//Even lower prio after the nerf, but only slightly.
Surprisingly viable, very decent for sustain, and you can simply sell it first later. It also just literally out dps' headshot booster, that item is only for very early poke, so I dont recommend it.
Essentially 4 extra health regen, over a minute thats 240 health healed (as long as your not in combat), this or Restorative Shot and you won't need to back.
This item, per gold value, is objectively busted, you certainly won't need it late game, but if your against a melee lane, buying it (and pressing the parry key) will net you kills.
If they have 4+ stuns on the enemy team, will probably sell, or build into indomitable for long range displacements like Bepop hook.
Warp stone is decent, but honestly, Stamina Mastery is just better in nearly every feasible way, only buy it if you really love it.
For the long range roots like Vindicta 1, you can't let them get close.
It's counterspell. What else do you want me to say?
Useful for Pocket ult.//Pocket ult just got nerfed, so the use cases for this item just dropped ever so slightly.
Bepop.
Very low priority, your 3 is the only thing we care about.
This finishes our spirit investment after buying Mercurial Magnum, buying it before then isn't usually optimal.// With the increased movespeed spirit scaling change this is now viable earlier.

Compress Cooldown Imbues onto our Kinetic Carbine / Paradoxical Swap!

Amazing item into Melee Playstyle players!
If we're in need of some early Shielding, & we're planning to build into a Barrier this trial!

Very solid option for most trials!                                                ( Against Spirit focused heroes tho, much better options )
I don't really care for this item, but it's here for my fellow Dox Enjoyers whom enjoy it!

If we're being destroyed by Spirit Burst Damage, this item is our friend!
If we're being destroyed by Pure Gun / Melee Damage, this item is our friend! ( If it's Hybrid Gun Damage, think about getting Disarming Hex instead )
This item helps us soak up Spirit Damage that cannot be dodged / has no cooldown.                ( Insanely good item )

This item isn't bad on the New Map, but there are plenty of ways to heal now!                                                                   ( Steam Vents / Healing Bats / Healing Candle Troopers )
Roleplay as Haze, this item is quite good on the newest map!      ( It also pops off of Friendly / Enemy Violet ults )
Versatile item that helps us in Offense / Defense!
Useful against Build-Up Effects / DoTs.                                       ( Not purchased often, but if we're against a problematic Infernus / Mirage... )
Useful against Pure Gun M1 Damage.                                            ( This item is not great against Hybrid M1 Damage, because it does not block the incoming Spirit Damage )
Thanos item for Late Game survivability!
Good item, but it's popped really easily.  ( However, If we need to stack our CC Immunity, tis a really good option for doing so )
Good against On-Hit Bullet Effects.                              ( Also decent against Gun Damage, but Metal Skin is better tailored for that )
This item is useful against heavy Spirit Nuke Damage.    ( It's even more useful if the Spirit Nuke in question is super ahead )
Survivability + Utility option for Late Game+                           ( Lowkey compy )
This item counters Indomitable, and it's one of the best CCs in the game!  ( AMAZING against Celeste / Vindicta )
If we're enduring CC Lock, this item is our friend...
Amazing item for Late Game, but If you have a Fed Teammate that you wish to support, this item CAN BE rushed.    ( Acquire If needed )
This item is Thanos without the Infinity Stones...             ( Acquire if needed )
Shuts down so many heroes, amazing item!            ( Acquire If needed )
Very good item, but I have been stepping away from it for now!  ( Duration Extender imbues onto our Pulse Grenade )
This item helps us actually confirm our Picks we get during Solo MM!      ( Can be Slotted into our Core, I just prefer more Gun focused )
This item pops their Indomitable, acquire if needed!
This item is quite literally Thanos with ALL of the Infinity Stones...   ( Acquire if needed )
*BONK*
This Item Upgrade is a huge Power Spike for our Abilities / Active + Passive Items!
If we're being Hate Crime'd by some type of Gimmick in Late Game, this item is quite nice!
Amazing item, but if our target has Indomitable, we may need to get a item to pop their indom first!                   ( Silence Wave tis a very good option )

6.author: Steam 482710023
6.name: Sniper Mommy [Fully annotated]
6.description:
[Kinetic Carbine does not have damage fall off, you can easily hit cross map 2k damage time shots.]

Kinetic Carbine has very interesting item synergies, this build has all of the ones that work, making it the best and original Paradox one-shot build.

items.note: Fun fact, Paradox Kinetic Carbine shot actually has travel speed, very strange for a literal shot of time energy but eh.
Don't sell until giga late game, it's essentially the perfect item for sniping.
Early game with these 3 items 3 starts dealing like 200 damage every 15s.// The early game isn't changed too much, but the damage drop really hurts late, be less hesitant to buy Mercurial Magnum.
Kind of goated, second highest pure damage item we get. //4.8k spike.
Just walk up to people for assists as they die. Sell lategame first once your slot locked and need T4's.//Every soul generating item got nerfed, so this thing is still good, relatively speaking.
Massive 3 damage, try to play around the cooldown, 3's cooldown starts ticking as soon as you start charging it, so you can wait for the very last second with no downtime.//Still good.
Veil walker got cooked, so Fortitude is back baby, and even better then before, the healing buff is minimal, but it's still a buff. Gives you 4.8k health, and a lot of global map pressure.
Testing has shown that this item outperforms Hollow Point for sniping, because of the large added damage to your shots, but unfortunately Carbine only gets the smaller secondary fire damage buff.
Good damage and the effect procks with carbine, so your target will lose resists and be easier to kill for you or your team, now it's almost always just better then Weighted Shots.
For those who have a soft spot for Veil Walker, you can still build it, even if it got decimated by the nerfs, it's still fun.
This item is underrated, which is strange, since everyone buys it, but I promise it is absurdly good for keeping space, it will save you far more often then 90% of greens.
This is literally just 50% more damage, and the aoe will easily deal thousands of damage in teamfights.
Highest gun damage item in the game, and since our playstyle is so safe its incredibly easy to stack.
Big nerfs to this item, in pure damage it is still the best option, but not by far, consider Crippling Headshot more often if they don't have healers.

It's mostly useful in longer fights, not as good for pure sniping, still, has massive value in teamfights, try to go for headshots if you're too far away to target one person, applying it to everyone.
Finish our gun investments, and good for normal gun damage. | You can replace it with a green that gives ~15% gun damage (since thats how much you get from final investment) if you wont m1.
Last item, we swap Mystic Shot for this, and altough our 3 damage does go down a bit, our base gun damage goes up.//The nerfs to this thing don't hit us nearly as hard as others, so it's still good.
The extra health does help in lane, and if you're going up against a melee/dangerous lane, you can pick it up early, especially since we're back to building Fortitude.
We take Stamina over other greens because it helps us stay out of other champion's effective range, we dont need to mitigate damage that we dont take.
Goated item, 15m is a lot less then you'd think, if your playing right your going to have the damage nigh permanently.
Low prio, it's decent if your entire team is gun carries tho.//Even lower prio after the nerf, but only slightly.
Surprisingly viable, very decent for sustain, and you can simply sell it first later. It also just literally out dps' headshot booster, that item is only for very early poke, so I dont recommend it.
Essentially 4 extra health regen, over a minute thats 240 health healed (as long as your not in combat), this or Restorative Shot and you won't need to back.
This item, per gold value, is objectively busted, you certainly won't need it late game, but if your against a melee lane, buying it (and pressing the parry key) will net you kills.
If they have 4+ stuns on the enemy team, will probably sell, or build into indomitable for long range displacements like Bepop hook.
Warp stone is decent, but honestly, Stamina Mastery is just better in nearly every feasible way, only buy it if you really love it.
For the long range roots like Vindicta 1, you can't let them get close.
It's counterspell. What else do you want me to say?
Useful for Pocket ult.//Pocket ult just got nerfed, so the use cases for this item just dropped ever so slightly.
Bepop.
Very low priority, your 3 is the only thing we care about.
This finishes our spirit investment after buying Mercurial Magnum, buying it before then isn't usually optimal.// With the increased movespeed spirit scaling change this is now viable earlier.

0.name: I love cat[girl]s! Skelly's Spirit Assassin Build
0.description:
Fully annotated!

This is a spirit build!
Check out my melee bruiser Calico build (not updated as frequently): 209974

items.note: Very common buy. Great healing in lane from punching minions. And we can optionally upgrade this into Lifestrike for more sustain.
Great damage and stats in lane and gives you move speed for chasing. The foostep sound reduction is also nice. And this gives you wallhacks from the DoT. This is also for the weapon investment bonus.
We upgrade this to Spirit Snatch later. Adds to our burst and trades with our 2.
Must buy for rotating around the map and ganking other lanes. Builds into Enduring Speed or Trophy Hunter. If not going Trophy Collector, get it after Spirit Snatch.
I think this is still mostly good. You can get Enduring Speed instead of this after Spirit Snatch if you prefer.
Adds to your burst damage, and the slow is great. We also can upgrade this into Arctic Blast.
Hits your 4.8k spirit investment spike. Spirit resist and power steal is amazing. Plus even more melee damage and it procs on your 2.
Nice for melee resist. If you want to kill minions and objectives, its as good as Monster Rounds. If you are planning to go more into gun, this builds into Point Blank for that.
Good item. Get if you need healing in lane. Typically better than Healing Rite for that.
You could get this much earlier in lane instead. We're mainly getting it here to hit our 4.8k spike. If you went Dispel Magic earlier, you can skip this.
Great against Viscous in lane since it works against Viscous Puddle Punches. Also a very good item against people building melee (Abrams and Billy). Only buy if you can actually parry consistently.
Great for move speed in fights and the slow resist. Lets you easily hit the second ult damage burst. You can get this instead of Trophy Collector, if so, buy it after Spirit Snatch.
Buffed! So much fun. Use off CD with heavy melee in lane for a 80+ health heal on a 4 sec CD. Lets you permafight/push in lane. Slow is super good as well.
Hits your 4.8k green investment. Must buy against Slowing Hex. Really great against a ton of characters.
Great for 1v1s. Gets you your 4.8k weapon investment. You could also go Mystic Shot + Spirit Shredder Bullets here instead.
Great damage over the course of a game/fight. Good for tankiness and farming. You could get this earlier instead of Spirit Snatch if you prefer.
Really great item, great for catching people and for clearing waves in cat form.
Good for damage, and builds into Boundless Spirit.
Gives you some much needed damage in the late game with your ult and gloom bombs. Great if you are trying to oneshot their carries.
Can swap for other things, not as strong as it used to be. Makes you really tanky and can do a lot of damage if you get into the middle of their team. Boundless is a good alternative here.
Cooldown reduction is really useful.
Great against certain characters and abilities. Especially Lash.
If you need anti-spirit. Very common buy although not absolutely necessary since we build many items that have spirit resist already. Always good.
Usually just go Metal Skin instead. In worst case scenario you could get this. But something like Plated Armor or maybe Disarming Hex will likely just be better.

items.note: Also adds hundreds of healing to each Scorn, but only when Scorn has 2 upgrades. Your second sold item if you need slots
Adds hundreds of healing to each Scorn. Rush this before Monster Rounds if you are healthy enough to save. Start trying to Scorn the enemies as much as possible.
Upgrade this to Enduring Speed earlier if vs certain characters with lots of slows, such as Kelvin.
Sell if you need a slot late game, it does feel bad to lose the movespeed so I usually sell it for Enduring Speed and Juggernaut
Use while burrowed to set up for your unburrow, or just use it while spinning. Use on tier 1 camps with Scorn to clear them instantly
Sell if you do not need it for Tankbuster, if you need the slot, sell it and delay tankbuster upgrade
This is Mo's best movement item in my opinion. You can use warp stone while burrowed to get on top of 1-story buildings and ridges. This expands Mo's getaway angles exponentially.
Don't let the cost of the item bait you, this is a late game counter item to teams with many M1's. Should use while burrowed or while ulting. Having resistances makes this item better.
Pretty much a guaranteed kill if you parry bait someone, but will only work once per person at most. Beyond that, melee resist feels very good since the burrow nerf.
Since you are buying Superior CD next, might as well put this on the ability you will use the most in between. Will -20 seconds on ult if full CD(dimishing depending on % CD)
Great item that synergyzes with Burrow, Combo and Scourge. This is a Defensive and Offensive Spike.
Buy this as soon as some loser on the enemy team thinks Indom is your hard counter
Usually Curse this item!
A good counter item to Dynamo if he keeps ulting your team. Very strong combo item with Cheat Death.
Almost always a buy. Necessary vs Knockdowns, Decays, Seven 2, Infernus, Knife Shiv, Mirage, Haze, etc.
Cheat Death+Unstoppable+Superior Duration = Someone is getting held for a long time. Build this vs fed Shiv's now that it beats Killing Blow
Can be decent into Infernus and Victor? Not a great item imo
Gives damage to whole team, and a little resist.
Imbue Burrow if they are never pulling you out, imbue sandblast if many M1s
Buy when needed, can buy at any point in the game. Generally bullet resist is less needed than spirit resist because of burrow. But if you are getting pulled out of burrow consistently may be needed.
An item to buy if you are weaker and want your ults to be better. Cheaper, but worse, than getting Unstoppable and Cheat Death
A good item to buy the enemies are playing outside of Warp Stone+Dash Range constantly
Great item versus certain heros, like Haze, Infernus, Wraith, and Mirage. I sometimes delay Scourage to buy this sooner depending on the enemy team.
VERY GOOD ITEM IF YOU GET USED TO USING IT
Can be a life saver vs quick stuns such as Abrams Charge, not incredibly needed vs Bebop since you can use burrow after being hooked anyways
Can buy this sooner if vs many slows (Kelvin, Viscous, etc.) Or if it helps you secure Unsecured Souls before a fight
Still good some games while ahead, allows you to stay on map and continue pressuring. Not great when behind since you are more likely to be close to base anyways
Very good item versus most heros, but Grey Talon, Lash, and Vindicta especially
Newly buffed and does a very large amount of damage, though slowly. It is also the best anti-heal other than Spirit Burn
Tempo Spirit Sap into mid game Silence Wave may be strong now

5.author: Steam 432810999
5.name: Highdocker's Gun Ivy Build
5.description:
This build is Heavily Annotated. All Items have Notes. Over 100 Paragraphs of annotations, notes, etc.

[EMERGENCY HOTFIX]
Yoshi does not allow you to publish builds with certain amounts of text up to a unknown limit. Several descriptions have been removed until this limit is changed.

10/31/2026 - Healing booster no longer builds from extra regen, so I fixed that build order and a few minor things. Added Bullet resil back due to its buff, and added MR and Egg to testing, as camps hurt more, and egg buffed

items.note: Good because it helps alleviate Ivy's poor magazine size problem. Gives more long term damage output for wave at the start, which means its a good alternative/supplement to Monster Rounds.
Greatly increases your magazine, allowing effortless waveclear, and lets you trade (Not often) sometimes with the enemy in lane with your raw gun. This will make your Tesla Bullets buy WAY better.
Gun Ivy's BEST early/mid game item. Procs easily with ivy's high ROF, grants amazing jungle/camp clear, and allows easy proccage of debuffs. It is INSANE.
This item is better the earlier you buy it, B/C Capacitor requires FAR LESS ROF to consistently proc than Tesla Bullets. Its active is a great substitute for ivy losing knockup on ultimate.
Slight damage increase. Powerspike more noticable when you buy swift striker.
INSANE item to buy if you want to postpone your 4.8k HP investment spike, to buy more items for farming and powerspikes, without being super squishy and burstable.
This item has INSANE value, even outside of lane. You will NEVER regret or feel bad buying this item, as it keeps you topped up for HP after camps, and gives sprint speed!
If planning to be hyper-active in the early game right after capacitor, this can be a good pickup against early healing characters. Otherwise, get crippling late. (~§35k+ souls)
Best § 800 item in lane for winning lane and applying pressure. If buying, I reccomend going Extnd. Mag -> Headshot Booster -> Tesla for you 4.8k Gun Spike build order.

Best § 1600 item for raw unconditional firerate, while giving bonus sprint speed that very useful in the early game. Helps immensely with giving the exact fire rate you need for capacitor w T3 Tether.

Given that your character has a short reload time (Ivy does), this item is great, as you will be allowed to easily proc it to gain very high value stats, such as lots of firerate, movespeed, lifesteal
Easy to apply with Tesla/Capacitor, and provides a great Bullet Resist Shred debuff while giving spirit investment, and good base stats.
Ivy's base kit has absolutely insane amounts of healing. This will make your bullet lifesteal from tether and stone form heal be far more effective, as well as headhunter. Builds into healing tempo.
Required every game for the current spirit meta, and works well with creating more EHP (Effective HP) with siphon bullets.
Insane counter to Infernus/Mirage on-hit buildups, and generally great for any enemy that is causing a debuff that is causing you to lose or die constantly. (Also good if spirit burned nonstop late.)

Now offers 35-50% effective bullet resistance. Compared to escalating resil with its poor stats (30%), this gives far more, and keeps you alive at low hp (which you have lots of sustain to heal from).
Insanely Overpowered, but situational. Hard counters Haze/Vyper/Gun Warden, Gun Drifter, and ANY character that has ~X > 75% damage done by pure weapon damage bullets.
Great item for mid-game firerate saturation. You want to hit a target of around +100-120% firerate by the time you are full build. Slide distance and movespeed this item gives is very good.
Though it doesnt give raw stats, the latest slow change where regular slows also effect air dashing can certainly make this item more desirable. Reccomended if up a walker flex slot.

When bought at around 20-25k souls, this item will actually feel effective due to characters starting to be at the 2500-3000HP range. Optimally, you want enemies to be at 3k+HP for this item to SHINE.
Can be bought earlier to make use of raw trade damage it provides. Real value comes from large % heal that is impactful late game when you are 4000-5000HP.
Often has more value if you buy this when behind to support other m1s, though you can still retain a fair amount of value from this item due to its abundance of passive stats.
Combined with Siphon bullets, and utilizing Ivy's above average health scaling, it gives great health value, and the dash slow on this item is INSANE. Great also if you have x < 15% of both resists.
Better with the diminishing movespeed buffs, and direct juggernaut movespeed buffs. Still, this item is optimal if you are using it to counter other m1s.
VERY good debuff that counts as antiheal and a massive damage reduction. Easy to buildup with your current firerate, and when bought, gives ~350 HP and +10% wpn damage in raw stats (Very Good)
While inhibitor is great, this item INSTANTLY applies the damage debuff without needing a buildup. Great for spirit meta. Built-In Silence is also great for countering. Do note this gives no HP.
Deletes victor, and heavily cripples any character that has high resists with high healing/sustain. Long debuff duration and easy proc makes it SUPER useful for your team needing damage.
You will have enough firerate to reproc it even when its debuff removed (At around T3 tether max). This makes it a good antiheal option for mid-late game, and really shines late with high HP pools.
Very good upgrade that mainly serves to give you debuff resist that you may otherwise be lacking in the midgame. Damage is great too. Good because other sources of debuff resist are very expensive.
Gives all the late game stats you are lacking, and want more of. Provides a layer of protection against spirit nukers, and gives slightly more resistance to what you already have, with debuff resist.

This item is great against pick characters (Mo Krill, Holliday, Paradox, Bepop, etc.) But not reccomended until §40k+ souls. It doesnt get triggered by knockups/airbornes (except mirage FUCK YOU mirag
VERY SITUATIONAL. Very good counter against Haze and Infernus. If not enough against on-hit characters, combining this with Dispel Magic practically makes their on-hits completely irrelevant.
Great when the team is only managing to kill you through CC/Stuns, or curses and countless debuffs of similar sort. Also gives survivability with massive debuff resistance and some HP.

Good as a early hard-counter to m1 characters during lane, or right after lane. Can be bought right after tesla for maximum value, though delaying capacitor is risky. Earlier fire rate slow is better.

With regular slows effecting air dashes as well now, this item can give you a little bit of the best of both worlds, making both movespeed and crazy airdashing harder, get only if you have many slots.

When imbued on ult, and you are carrying people off cooldown, you can be perma rotating around mid-game skirmishes getting major map control and granting you a lead. Good if you have/know u have slots

Treat this as a § 50k+ Soul Luxury item to let you proc Headhunter, Siphon, and Capacitor faster, alongside giving ability cooldowns. Very high value late game, but useless if you are buying it early.
A very good replacement for Bullet Resist Shredder, when you are heavily slot locked, but have money to spend. Usually only do this at § 35k+ souls when you are missing slots from walkers.
Here for the sake of being an easily accessible component for when you want to buy crippling headshot, and have a slot to spare for it. ONLY BUY IF BUILDING FOR CRIPPLING.

categories.name: TESTING | CAN BE GOOD | FULL IVY GUIDE BELOW - SCROLL DOWN

items.note: If bought, pop for capacitor. Never for tesla.
Only buy if you need to stack significant DBR while being affordable. With Weighted shots and this, you have 40% DBR. Great against characters with ults like Holliday, Mo & Krill, given you have HP.

Can be worth your while if you dont buy many other mid/late extras (primarily replacing slowing bullets), allows for magazine uptime on camps and players. Reccomended to have fire rate before using it
This is a luxury item. Often only consider after § 50k Souls, as proccing this item is rather difficult, but it can replace one of your § 1600 firerate/shred items in the late game.
This should exclusively be used as a § 50k+ soul counter if the enemy has multiple plated armors, or a single high priority target has plated. If bought before 50k souls, it often has reduced value.

categories.name: Niche Tip 4 - Stone Form Height Cancel
